info.name: Dreamina API v1 by useapi.net
info.description:
Experimental API for Dreamina by ByteDance. Video models: Seedance 2.0 (US+CA; 1080p CA-only), 2.0 Fast (US+CA), 1.5 Pro (US+CA), 1.0 Pro (CA), 1.0 Mini (US+CA), 1.0 Fast (CA), Sora2 (CA). Image models: Seedream 5.0 Lite, 4.6, 4.5, 4.1, 4.0, Nano Banana, 3.0, GPT Image 2 (CA only). Supports US and CA regions, 720p/1080p resolution, video upscale (2x super resolution).

**Features:**

- Multiple Dreamina accounts with automated load balancing
    
- Real-time webhooks for job events (replyUrl parameter)
    
- Async image and video generation with job polling
    
- Dynamic concurrency management
    
- Image upload for reference frame and image generation support
    

**Commands:**

- [POST /accounts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-accounts) - Configure Dreamina account
    
- [GET /accounts](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-accounts) - List all configured accounts
    
- [GET /accounts/<account>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-accounts-account) - Get account details, models, credits
    
- [DELETE /accounts/<account>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/delete-dreamina-accounts-account) - Delete account configuration
    
- [POST /assets/<account>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-assets-account) - Upload images (JPEG, PNG, WebP)
    
- [GET /assets/<account>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-assets-account) - List generation history
    
- [DELETE /assets/<assetId>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/delete-dreamina-assets-assetid) - Delete asset from history
    
- [POST /videos](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-videos) - Generate videos
    
- [GET /videos/<jobid>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-videos-jobid) - Get video job status and results
    
- [POST /images](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-images) - Generate images
    
- [GET /images/<jobid>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-images-jobid) - Get image job status and results
    
- [POST /videos/upscale](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-videos-upscale) - Upscale video (2x super resolution)
    
- [POST /videos/interpolate](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-videos-interpolate) - Frame interpolation (30/60 FPS)
    
- [POST /images/upscale](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-images-upscale) - Upscale generated image
    
- [GET /scheduler](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-scheduler) - List executing jobs
    
- [DELETE /scheduler/<jobid>](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/delete-dreamina-scheduler-jobid) - Cancel executing job
    

Visit [https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1) for complete documentation.

---
**Updated:** February 23, 2026 (April 17, 2026)

request.description:
Configure your Dreamina account for API access using email and password credentials.

See [Setup Dreamina](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-dreamina) for detailed instructions.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-accounts)

Get configuration details for a specific Dreamina account, including session status, available models, and credit balance. Can also be called once a day to claim free daily credits.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-accounts-account)

Delete a configured Dreamina account. Removes the account from your configuration and cleans up any executing job entries.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/delete-dreamina-accounts-account)

Upload images to Dreamina for use as reference frames in video and image generation.

Supports JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats up to 10 MB. Returns assetRef for use in POST /videos and POST /images.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-assets-account)

query.description: Number of assets to return (1-100, default: 20). Optional.
Pagination cursor from previous response's nextOffset. Optional.

request.description:
List generation history (images and videos) for a specific account. Returns assets with their URLs, dimensions, and reusable assetRef values for POST /images or as in POST /videos.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-assets-account)

Delete a specific asset (image or video) from generation history.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/delete-dreamina-assets-assetid)

formdata.value: Two cool cats walking and talking
formdata.description: Text prompt for video generation. Required for T2V mode. Max 5000 characters.

AI model (default: seedance-2.0). US region: seedance-2.0 (720p only), seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-1.5-pro, seedance-1.0-mini. CA region: all of the above plus seedance-2.0-mini, seedance-1.0-pro, seedance-1.0-fast, sora2, and seedance-2.0 at 1080p/4k. Optional.
Specific account to use. Auto-selected if omitted. Optional.
Aspect ratio: 21:9, 16:9 (default), 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Cannot be used with image refs. Optional.
Duration in seconds. seedance-2.0 and seedance-2.0-mini: 4-15, seedance-1.5-pro: 5/10/12, seedance-1.0-mini: 5/10, sora2: 4/8/12. Default: 5. Optional.

Output resolution: 720p (default), 1080p, or 4k. 1080p supported by seedance-2.0 (CA only), seedance-1.5-pro, seedance-1.0-mini, and seedance-1.0-fast. 4k supported by seedance-2.0 (CA only). seedance-1.0-pro is always 1080p. seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0-mini, and sora2 are 720p only. Optional.
assetRef from POST /assets for starting frame. Triggers first_frame mode. Optional.
assetRef for ending frame. Triggers end_frame mode. Requires firstFrameRef. Optional.
assetRef for keyframe 1. Multi-frame mode (seedance-1.0-mini, min 2 frames). Optional.
Per-frame prompt for keyframe 1. Max 5000 characters. Optional.
Per-frame duration for keyframe 1 (1-6, default: 5). Optional.
assetRef for keyframe 2. Optional.
Per-frame prompt for keyframe 2. Optional.
Per-frame duration for keyframe 2. Optional.
Webhook URL for job status callbacks. Optional.
Custom reference string passed back in webhook callbacks. Optional.
Override max concurrent jobs for this request (1-50). Optional.

request.description:
Generate videos using Dreamina AI models. Supports text-to-video, first frame (I2V), end frame, and multi-frame keyframe modes.

Async by default — returns immediately with a job ID. Poll GET /videos/<jobid> for completion.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-videos)

Retrieve the status and result of a video generation job. Poll this endpoint after POST /videos. Jobs are retained for 30 days.

When status is 'completed', response.videoUrl contains the download URL.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-videos-jobid)

formdata.description: Job ID of a completed video generation job from POST /videos. Required.
Webhook URL for job status callbacks. Optional.
Custom reference string passed back in webhook callbacks. Optional.
Override max concurrent jobs for this request (1-50). Optional.

request.description:
Upscale a generated video to 2x resolution (super resolution). Doubles width and height — 720p becomes 1440p, 1080p becomes 4K. Each video can only be upscaled once.

Poll GET /videos/<jobid> for the upscaled result.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-videos-upscale)

formdata.description: Job ID of a completed video generation or video upscale job. Required.
Target frame rate: 30 or 60 (from 24 FPS source). Required.
Webhook URL for job status callbacks. Optional.
Custom reference string passed back in webhook callbacks. Optional.
Override max concurrent jobs for this request (1-50). Optional.

request.description:
Interpolate a generated video to 30 or 60 FPS (from 24 FPS source). Works on both original and upscaled videos. Each video can only be interpolated once.

Poll GET /videos/<jobid> for the interpolated result.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-videos-interpolate)

formdata.value: A stunning aurora borealis over a frozen lake at midnight
formdata.description: Text prompt for image generation. Optional when model supports imageRef_N. Max 1600 characters.

AI model: seedream-5.0-lite (free), seedream-4.7 (CA only), seedream-4.6 (default, free), seedream-4.5, seedream-4.1, seedream-4.0 (free), nano-banana, seedream-3.0, gpt-image-2 (CA only, 1k, 3 refs, ratios 1:1/2:3/3:2). Optional.
Specific account to use. Auto-selected if omitted. Not needed when imageRef_N provided. Optional.
Aspect ratio: auto (default), 1:1, 3:4, 16:9, 4:3, 9:16, 2:3, 3:2, 21:9. Optional.
Output resolution: 1k, 2k, 4k. Default depends on model. Optional.
Reference image assetRef from POST /assets or completed image job. Optional.
Reference image 2. Optional.
Reference image 3. Optional.
Reference image influence strength (0-1, default: 0.5). Optional.
Webhook URL for job status callbacks. Optional.
Custom reference string passed back in webhook callbacks. Optional.
Override max concurrent jobs for this request (1-50). Optional.

request.description:
Generate images using Dreamina AI models from text prompts with optional reference images. Each generation produces up to 4 images.

Async by default — returns immediately with a job ID. Poll GET /images/<jobid> for completion.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-images)

Retrieve the status and result of an image generation or upscale job. Poll this endpoint after POST /images or POST /images/upscale. Jobs are retained for 30 days.

When status is 'completed', response.images contains the generated images with URLs and assetRef values.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-images-jobid)

Upscale a generated image to higher resolution (2K, 4K, or 8K). Requires a completed image generation job from POST /images.

Poll GET /images/<jobid> for the result.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/post-dreamina-images-upscale)

List all currently executing (in-progress) image and video generation jobs, grouped by account.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/get-dreamina-scheduler)

Cancel an executing job. If the job is still in 'created' status, it will be marked as failed with reason 'Cancelled by user'.

[Documentation](https://useapi.net/docs/api-dreamina-v1/delete-dreamina-scheduler-jobid)
